items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, I heard Sam on record, but I never heard much of Bill. No, right. William.

ctx.x: They both was in the Navy bands, John's brothers.
Well, I heard Sam on record, but I never heard much of Bill. No, right. William. I think he made some records, but they don't sound as good as...

What did they take fellas like off? I remember way back when the Lyric Theater was running, used to be a little nice job, around on the other road street, but we used to play in there. Same Bonnie Begaard, there was where his home's from. Bonnie used to come around there and set in. He'd just commenced the lining at that time.
